reviews.x: I love buying inexpensive items to use with makeup because most of the time you get a really good product at a great price. On Amazon, there are SO many makeup brushes to choose from, and I've gotten quite a few. I wanted to try this to use with my blush and contour. My brush arrived on time and safely in a bubble wrap manila envelope. Sometimes I wonder if other customers get their brushes in this type of packaging, and if so - that is possibly why their brushes arrive broken. Even in a bubble

reviews.t: Try this before the high end brush
reviews.x: For the price you can't beat it. The brush does exactly what it says and that is contour my face. I wasn't expecting the quality to be too much since it's just a Amazon brush, but to my surprise this brush has passed several "wash test". It it is still standing after at least 4 washes and I have seen no sign of bristles coming out or the brush falling apart. So glad I purchased this over it's high end counter part!

I am new at contouring and I cannot get enough of this brush! It is so precise and makes the whole process a lot easier! My contour looks nearly perfect and in combination of using a good matte bronzer such as bahama mama by the balm, my contour is always easy to apply!

reviews.t: Wouldn't recommended it. I used it to contour my face ...
reviews.x: Wouldn't recommended it. I used it to contour my face but it didn't work out. It picked up a lot of product but did not get on my face. So basically a waste.

I like this brush a lot. Great for contouring! Bristles are just stiff enough to do the job of holding product on the brush and placing it precisely. Very soft on the face and great quality for the price. I've used nearly every grade of brush from drugstore brands to professional quality and this is a high contender with higher grade brushes. I would definitely recommend this brush, you won't be disappointed. Also very fast shipping, no shedding of the brush yet, sturdy build, no weak points in

reviews.t: The bristles do not line up evenly on top, ...
reviews.x: The bristles do not line up evenly on top, and they're a little twisty when you look down.  From the sides you wouldn't be able to tell, but makes for slightly difficult blending.
When I received the product the bottom half was clearly half way off and without any force I easily separated the two. No quality whatsoever!
So it came detached. The brush separated from the holder. The bristles themselves were too soft and of poor quality. Wouldn't recommend.
It came already broken. Wouldn't recommend.

reviews.t: Good for the price. Expect it to break.
reviews.x: I rate it between 3 and 4.  The metal fell off the wooden part, but I used Superglue to stick them back together. For the price, I found this acceptable. I'm no professional in make up, I like to keep it natural. This brush helps contour my cheekbones, and I love it honestly.  Are there better brushes? Definitely. But this, to me at least, serves the same purpose, AND IS SO CHEAP!  If I lost my brush, would I buy another one? I would, but I might want to try something else for the sake of trying

reviews.t: it's like the best bronzer/contour brush I've ever purchased in my ...
reviews.x: So I was a bit iffy and unsure if I should buy this brush at first. I ended up giving in and purchasing it. Well let me tell you... it's like the best bronzer/contour brush I've ever purchased in my life! I've had this brush a little over a month and I've had NO bristle fallouts or anything. I use it literally EVERYDAY. The brush is super soft and is dense enough to give you the right amount of product. I will definitely be purchasing more of these brushes!

reviews.t: It Does Have A Fair Big Problem
reviews.x: I love the way this brush looks, feels, applies product. I would have been all for a 5 star review except and this is a pretty big except...it takes two or more days to dry when you clean it!  The bristles are just way too dense and by the time it does dry it gets that funky sat to long wet smell.  Personally anything smelling like that is getting nowhere near my face.  So it sits lonely and begging for a purpose that I can't give it.

I ususally buy all my makeup and tools from Sephora or ulta but I didn't want to spend another $30 on a contour brush that I may not like. This brush is by far the best contouring brush I have found in the past 2 years. the bristles are flexible enough to blend but sturdy and short enough to stay in a slender shaped space so it isn't smearing a darker color all over your face. seriously I cant express how much I love this brush.

reviews.t: I took a chance on this brush and NOT sorry at all :-)!
reviews.x: I give it 5 stars! My brush arrived intact. Even though there were a few complaints of it coming apart, I took a chance and it paid off. I even tried pulling to see if it would break and nope, stayed put.  This is waaaay better than spending lots of money on "Big Name brushes" that at the end of the day, do the exact same thing as this one.  Buy it, and if it comes apart... that's what Super Glue is for ;-)

reviews.t: I like to use this to contour around my jawline
reviews.x: I like to use this to contour around my jawline. It's perfect for that. I didn't care for it too much on the cheeks because it didn't feel like it blended as well. Bristles are soft, densely packed, and the brush itself doesn't feel cheap or flimsy. My only complaint is after I washed it and dried it delicately, it never quiet returned to its original shape. However, it's still useable.

When this arrived in the mail, I pulled it out by the handle and the brush split apart. The black stem wasn't properly glued into the silver part. So now I have a very short brush that works decently well.  You get what you pay for, I guess. I'm going to use this for now, but it's worth it to spend a few more dollars and get something better quality.

Was happy to receive my brush but for some reason the bristles on my brush were a lot longer than the picture. It was like a paintbrush almost. I wasnt very happy with that so i had to trim it off to get the desired length of the brush myself. It makes a very flawless contour brush i must add once i cut trimmed the top.

reviews.t: This is a great contouring brush
reviews.x: This is a great contouring brush. It is pretty large, but it is good for applying contour and for blending it in. I love that it is stiff and flat. Very easy to use. I was previously using a blush brush to contour, and this brush makes contouring much easier! Very happy with my purchase!

Well, I was really excited for this brush, since I have been playing around with contouring. I opened it up out of the package and it was broken. I can probably tweet it to make it work, but I shouldn't have to do this. Not very happy at all

reviews.t: and blends so great. stiff enough to be precise
reviews.x: I bought this as a contour/bronzer brush for my cheek bones...WOW. it puts the product right where I want it, and blends so great. stiff enough to be precise, but soft enough to not make you look like a clown. Love love love this brush!

I am very pleased w this brush.. i have other high end brushes which i love and didnt think id b as happy.. but this one is so cheap and works great! I use it to contour & it gives a fool proof line across the cheak.

I am really disappointed in this brush.  The second time I used it bristles came out.  I don't get the effect I want with it of course it could be my technique.  I do think it should not have shed that quickly.

reviews.t: It's wider than I'd like it to be
reviews.x: The brush has more bristles than expected. It's wider than I'd like it to be. In the photo it looks like it's very narrow but it's not. So it's not that great for a clean contour cut line for the cheeks

reviews.t: Not the best but, the worst
reviews.x: Not the best but, the worst. I use it everyday. It's starting to come apart with the silver detaching from the black handle but some super glue will fix that issue right up.
Not a densely packed brush..bristles too loose for baking my face which is what i bought it for..disappointed. brush broke in half after one month..was loose upon arrival

claims.text: Many reviewers find it an effective and precise contouring brush, especially good value for the price.
Several reviewers report the brush arrived broken or fell apart, with the handle separating from the metal ferrule.
Some reviewers note the bristles are densely packed, which makes the brush slow to dry after washing.
A few reviewers mention uneven or twisty bristles that make blending more difficult.
One reviewer found it picked up product but failed to apply it to the face.
